messages:
Maya: Quick check — brought up opal-9b v1 (mixed int6/fp16) last night. 10k sample smoke: short-context ok, long-context summarization (5k-10k tokens) ROUGE-L -4.5 pts.
Gopal: Which slice — length or content?
Maya: Length; <=512 flat. Traces show KV-cache flushes above ~3k tokens; kv-hit drops.
Sophie: Int6 path might disable fused attention for safety; that can cause fallback and higher compute.
Ara: Confirmed: mixed int6 runtime disables large fused kernel for mem-safety; increases tail latency.
James: 99p latency for long docs? Product needs <800ms.
Maya: 99p rose from 620ms -> 980ms on long-doc canary. Short docs unchanged.
Sophie: Prod traces: ~7% requests >3k tokens but ~28% of token spend.
Maya: Unit-econ rough: 13b fp16 ~$0.045/1k tokens; opal-9b int6 ~$0.035/1k overall, but long-doc effective ~$0.06/1k due to fallback/latency.
Ara: Proposal: hybrid routing — opal-9b int6 for <=3k, route >3k to 13b fp16. Keeps cost for bulk and preserves SLOs.
James: Product ok with transparent routing if latency stable.
Maya: Rollout plan: 2% canary hybrid routing; monitor per-slice ROUGE-L, p99 latency, errors, kv-hit; accept if ROUGE-L <=1pt regression and p99 <800ms; auto-rollback on violation.
Gopal: Add synthetic long-doc perf probe every minute to detect cache-path regressions quickly.
Sophie: Scorecard fields: model_name, quant_profile, slice_name, pct_tokens, token_cost_per_1k, rougel_delta, p99_latency_ms, rollout_pct, verdict.
Ara: Ops needs routing flag allow-hybrid-opal9b=true; gate to staging/team env first.
Sophie: Also propose int4 microbake for <=1k at 1% to test deeper cost wins without QA hit.
Maya: Next: I'll add synthetic probe PR (ETA EOD); Sophie drafts scorecard schema; Ara lands routing flag; Gopal prepares short vs long eval slices + final unit-econ for GTN doc. ops-bot: Canary scheduled: hybrid 2% at 2026-03-24T18:00Z
James: Keep PMs looped. :thumbsup:
